Pseudo Elements

A pseudo-element is a special CSS keyword that lets you style a specific part of an HTML element or add virtual content without changing the HTML code.

Types of Pseudo-elements

1.::before :Inserts content before an element

2.::after :Inserts content after an element

3.::first-letter :Styles the first letter of text

4.::first-line :Styles the first line of text

5.::selection :Styles selected (highlighted) text

6.::placeholder :Styles the placeholder text in input fields
